definitions.pinned_interfaces: every interface parsed out of the vendored release tree by wasmdown.wit
definitions.bound: present in the runtime registry for that exact release (p2-builder-table / %wasi-provider-builders)
definitions.excluded: pinned but withheld by an explicit decision (wasi:http removed; @unstable feature-gated off)
definitions.export_only: the world EXPORTS the interface, so it is not an import and never gets a provider entry
definitions.missing: pinned, stable, and neither bound nor excluded nor an export
definitions.types_only: interface declares no function and no resource; a guest resolves its types structurally
